rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City's Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers and enforces the Rent Control Ordinance. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt. Landlords must apply to the city for capital improvement or hardship increases, and tenants may petition over illegal rent or failure to maintain service.
rules.key_value: Rent control for buildings with 5+ units
citation_aliases: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties exempt; other exemptions through a Rent Control Exemption Request. State law exempts new multiple dwellings for 30 years (N.J.S.A. 2A:42-84.5).

unverifiable_exemptions: other permitted exemptions granted through Rent Control Exemption Request

rules.review_note: Ordinance adoption date not stated in the documents; no effective date given.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance is enforced publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination services; fines up to $2,000 per day
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day
rules.effective_date_note: Law-firm alert says effective June 2025; no day given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43, eff. 7/1/2027) may preempt this ordinance once in effect; not described in this document.

parsed.notes: Merged duplicate algorithmic-pricing candidates (c91, c98). The documents show no Jersey City rules for just cause, deposits, screening fees or screening restrictions; those are governed by NJ state law. D035 is link-only (Hudson County View on the RealPage ban), so it adds nothing beyond the algorithmic rule.
